name: inner-pr
about: One inner PR of a larger change, as a chain: contract, blind test writer, ledger r0 when the PR's tests pin behaviour the old code already has, implementer, ledger r1, validator, draft PR, /simplify, two reviews at once, triage, fixers, CI, merge. The coordinator is rung at the two gates (accept, merge) and on an exception.
start: router.py chain <pr> --def templates/inner-pr.json WT=<the PR's worktree> ISSUE=<the sub-issue's number> BASE_BRANCH=<the integration branch> TITLE='<pr>: <goal>' RUN_CONTEXT='<one or two sentences about this run>' TESTS=1 LEDGER=1 GREEN_PINNED= IMPL_EFFORT=high

variables.WT: the PR's worktree, on the PR's branch, cut from the PR's base commit
variables.ISSUE: the number of the sub-issue whose 'For the agent' comment is this PR's intent; the coordinator keeps its text at {SCRATCH}/intent/<number>.md, where every worker reads it
variables.BASE_BRANCH: the integration branch the PR merges into (never main). It has no default: a chain started without BASE_BRANCH=<branch> is refused before anything runs
variables.RUN_CONTEXT: one or two sentences about this run that every worker should know, for example the upgrade or feature the PR belongs to; empty by default
variables.TITLE: the PR title
variables.TESTS: 1 when a blind test writer runs; empty for a PR that only moves a dependency version, where the move can turn existing tests red and only the implementer may fix them: there the contract names every test the implementer writes or changes
variables.LEDGER: 1 when the PR has code to mutate; empty for a PR with none (a version move, a configuration change)
variables.GREEN_PINNED: 1 when the PR's tests pin behaviour the old code already has, so the ledger runs a round 0 on the old code; empty otherwise
variables.IMPL_EFFORT: high; xhigh for a PR whose implementation is the hardest of the run (a version bump with many red tests, a large rewrite)
variables.EXTRA_SUITE: the path of one extra test suite the validator runs as its own run, for example a contract or ABI suite; empty when the repository has none
variables.GOLDENS: the path of the golden files the PR must not change unless its contract says so; empty when the repository has none
variables.SCRATCH: the run directory, from the environment

files.ledger: {SCRATCH}/ledger/{PR}/ledger-r0.md and ledger-r1.md; a line 'VERDICT: PASS <n> killed, 0 survived' or 'VERDICT: SURVIVORS <n> of <m>'
files.triage: {SCRATCH}/reviews/{PR}/triage.md with a line 'VERDICT: TRIAGED <n> fix-code, <m> fix-tests, <k> discarded'; fix-code.md and fix-tests.md hold the work for the fixers and are empty or absent when there is none
files.fixers: {SCRATCH}/reviews/{PR}/fix-tests-done.md and fix-code-done.md, each with a first line 'VERDICT: OK <n> of <n> items done' or 'VERDICT: PARTIAL <k> of <n> items done'; a survivor the test fixer killed stays SURVIVED in the ledger, and fix-tests-done.md is the record that it was killed
files.pr body: {SCRATCH}/pr/{PR}.md, written by the validator step's worker from the contract

steps.title: contract acceptance: run the checklist on {SCRATCH}/contracts/{PR}.md, post it on the sub-issue, then resume
show: grep -c OPEN {SCRATCH}/contracts/{PR}.md | sed 's/^/lines that say OPEN: /'

checks: if test -n {TESTS}; then {CHECKS}/xfail-only.py {WT} {HEAD_AFTER_TESTS} {HEAD_AFTER} tests/; else echo 'OK xfail-only: no test writer on this PR'; fi

steps.title: ready to merge into {BASE_BRANCH}: mark ready, merge, tick the checkbox, then resume
show: if test -n {LEDGER}; then {CHECKS}/verdict-line.sh {SCRATCH}/ledger/{PR}/ledger-r1.md; else echo 'OK ledger: no code to mutate on this PR'; fi
if test -s {SCRATCH}/reviews/{PR}/fix-tests.md; then {CHECKS}/verdict-line.sh {SCRATCH}/reviews/{PR}/fix-tests-done.md; else echo 'OK fix-tests: triage had no test work'; fi
if test -s {SCRATCH}/reviews/{PR}/fix-code.md; then {CHECKS}/verdict-line.sh {SCRATCH}/reviews/{PR}/fix-code-done.md; else echo 'OK fix-code: triage had no code work'; fi
